item.title: [+1] US says it is 'very close' to finalising a trade deal with India; talks in Mumbai on 20 October
item.description:
The US Secretary of State said the deal was 'taken into account' when waiving Russia-oil sanctions. India says the first phase is in legal drafting. Escalating progress.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Lower US tariffs

Why it matters: A signed deal would cut US tariffs on Indian goods and reduce the risk of renewed Russia-oil penalties, lifting exporters and investor sentiment.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Foreign investor flows +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
